description_en: Retrieves the current configuration of a specified knowledge base build task
description_zh: 读取指定知识库构建任务的当前配置
name: GetKnowledgeBaseBuildTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

Code.description_en: The business error code. You can use this code to determine the error type when a request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

ContentLocale.description_en: The content language for the task. This parameter is optional and is explicitly specified during task creation
ContentLocale.description_zh: 本任务内容语言，可选；由任务创建时明确选择

Input.description_en: The typed input scope selected for the task. System-managed upload build tasks do not have fixed inputs, so this field is omitted in the response
Input.description_zh: 任务选择的类型化输入范围。系统托管的上传构建任务没有固定输入，读取时省略本字段

Entities.description_en: The Data Map entities, such as databases, schemas, and tables, selected for data asset-scoped builds. The list must not be empty and must contain unique values
Entities.description_zh: 数据资产范围构建选择的数据库、Schema、表等数据地图实体；非空、去重

EntityId.description_en: The metadata entity ID returned by Data Map. The client must pass this ID as is and must not concatenate database, schema, or table identifiers
EntityId.description_zh: 数据地图返回的元数据实体 ID；客户端原样传递，不自行拼接数据库、Schema 或表标识

EntityType.description_en: The entity level, such as DATABASE, SCHEMA, or TABLE. The server validates this based on Data Map identities. The presence of an enum value does not guarantee support across all engines
EntityType.description_zh: 实体层级，如 DATABASE、SCHEMA、TABLE；服务端以数据地图身份校验，不因枚举存在就承诺所有引擎均支持

KnowledgeObjectIds.description_en: Required when building from document objects in the knowledge base. The list must not be empty and must contain unique values. Each item is a KnowledgeObjectId with Type=DOCUMENT in the knowledge base. Do not mix this with SourceIds used for external connector synchronization scopes
KnowledgeObjectIds.description_zh: 从本库文档对象构建时必填、非空且去重；每项为本库 Type=DOCUMENT 的 KnowledgeObjectId；与外部连接器同步范围 SourceIds 不混用

items.description_en: Required when building from document objects in the knowledge base. The list must not be empty and must contain unique values. Each item is a KnowledgeObjectId with Type=DOCUMENT in the knowledge base. Do not mix this with SourceIds used for external connector synchronization scopes
items.description_zh: 从本库文档对象构建时必填、非空且去重；每项为本库 Type=DOCUMENT 的 KnowledgeObjectId；与外部连接器同步范围 SourceIds 不混用

ProjectIds.description_en: The IDs of the DataWorks workspaces selected for workspace-scoped builds. The list must not be empty and must contain unique values
ProjectIds.description_zh: 工作空间范围构建选择的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；非空、去重

items.description_en: The IDs of the DataWorks workspaces selected for workspace-scoped builds. The list must not be empty and must contain unique values
items.description_zh: 工作空间范围构建选择的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；非空、去重

SourceIds.description_en: The IDs of the registered sources in the knowledge base. The list must contain unique values. Whether this parameter is required and the allowed source types depend on the task input scenario. Refer to the following table
SourceIds.description_zh: 本库已登记来源的 ID，去重；是否必填及允许的来源类型由任务输入场景决定，见下表

items.description_en: The IDs of the registered sources in the knowledge base. The list must contain unique values. Whether this parameter is required and the allowed source types depend on the task input scenario. Refer to the following table
items.description_zh: 本库已登记来源的 ID，去重；是否必填及允许的来源类型由任务输入场景决定，见下表

YamlUploadId.description_en: The YAML upload session ID in the knowledge base used for SEMANTIC_MODEL import tasks. This ID is bound during task creation and cannot be mixed with other input scopes
YamlUploadId.description_zh: SEMANTIC_MODEL 导入任务使用的本库 YAML 上传会话 ID；创建任务时绑定，不能混用其他输入范围

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the associated knowledge base

LlmModel.description_en: The large language model (LLM) configured for tasks that require a model. You can specify a model ID or set this parameter to AUTO. If omitted during creation, the value defaults to AUTO. Do not configure this parameter for tasks that do not invoke a model
LlmModel.description_zh: 需要模型的任务可配置具体模型 ID 或 AUTO；创建时省略等价于 AUTO，不调用模型的任务不配置

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the definition was last modified

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace where the task runs. This differs from the build asset scope specified by Input.ProjectIds
ProjectId.description_zh: 任务运行所在的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；不同于 Input.ProjectIds 指定的构建资产范围

RuntimeResource.description_en: The resource group and Builder compute specifications for task execution
RuntimeResource.description_zh: 任务运行资源组及 Builder 计算规格

Cu.description_en: The Builder compute specifications. Valid values: 4 to 16. If omitted during creation, the default value is 4. The response returns the effective value
Cu.description_zh: Builder 计算规格，取值 4～16；创建省略时有效值为 4，读取返回有效值

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks resource group used by the actual Builder nodes. The server validates its availability in the workspace corresponding to the top-level ProjectId of the task
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 真实 Builder 节点使用的 DataWorks 资源组 ID；服务端校验其在任务顶层 ProjectId 对应工作空间内可用

Trigger.description_en: The manual or periodic trigger configuration

Cron.description_en: Provided only for PERIODIC tasks. The cron expression for DataWorks scheduling
Cron.description_zh: 仅 PERIODIC 提供；DataWorks 调度 Cron 表达式

Enabled.description_en: Provided only for PERIODIC tasks. Controls the enabling and disabling of periodic automatic triggers. This does not indicate the instance status
Enabled.description_zh: 仅 PERIODIC 提供；控制周期自动触发的启停，不是实例状态

Mode.description_en: The trigger mode. Valid values: MANUAL and PERIODIC. Manual nodes do not support automatic creation of instances
Mode.description_zh: MANUAL 或 PERIODIC；手动任务不自动创建实例

Type.description_en: The task type. Valid values: PROJECT_SPACE_BUILD, SEMANTIC_GRAPH, DOCUMENT_GRAPH, DOCUMENT_SYNC, DOCUMENT_SYNC_AND_GRAPH, and SEMANTIC_MODEL. SEMANTIC_MODEL is used only for YAML import
Type.description_zh: 任务类型：PROJECT_SPACE_BUILD、SEMANTIC_GRAPH、DOCUMENT_GRAPH、DOCUMENT_SYNC、DOCUMENT_SYNC_AND_GRAPH、SEMANTIC_MODEL；SEMANTIC_MODEL 仅用于 YAML 导入

Message.description_en: The secure error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
